notes.title: Free prologue with new boss and secret mission!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are excited to present the new and mysterious free game Union of Gnomes: Prologue. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/

It combines the creepy atmosphere of dark fantasy, cheerful humor, and, of course, the daring gnomes desperately fighting for their freedom and independence. 
 
[previewyoutube=atZ26XQlAEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Lead a motley crew of guerrillas to free your captured comrades and escape the tyranny of the ruthless Snow White. For the tenacious players, we've hidden a secret quest within the prologue—conquering it will bring you closer to solving the mystery of the eighth gnome! Look for the clue in the video!

Here's what you'll find in the game:

 One new, unique and terribly dangerous mission!
 A dangerous new boss!
 A secret quest!
 A lot of well-known – and not so well-known – fairy tale characters who fight on the side of evil, trying to suppress and destroy the gnomes!
 Create unusual combos with your gnome cards to reach the end of the prologue or die with honor!

Once you've finished the prologue (and added Union of Gnomes to your Steam Wishlist), you can look forward to the full story of the gnomes' heroic adventures as they fight for their freedom in the full game. The gnomes stand for freedom and the right not to impose subjugation on anyone else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 

Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends and favorite streamers, share your impressions, and leave a review. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: All new HeroCraft PC games are 20% off!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

From June 29th to July 13th, there will be the usual Summer Sale on Steam! To celebrate this joyous event, we've made a new bundle that includes all of our recently released games. Get this bundle at a 20% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33414/Heroes__Crafts/

The bundle includes:


 Revival: Recolonization. Set in a post-apoc version of Earth, Revival is a 4x strategy game where the world and its rules can change at key moments, creating a deep and highly replayable experience.
 Catizens. Inspired by RimWorld and The Sims, Catizens is a colony management simulation game where you watch over unique cats with quirky personalities, as you help them build and grow their settlement while exploring new lands, facing off against wildlife and overcoming the challenges of each environment.
 Anvil Saga is a management sim with RPG elements where you take control of a blacksmith shop amidst the Hundred Years' War. Each decision you make impacts the story and gameplay.
 Organs Please. A dark and satirical management sim, where you take control of a recycling factory with a twist: it recycles humans. Your job is to decide who gets to escape our dying planet in a cozy spaceship and who sacrifices their blood, sweat and tears for humanity. Literally.

Treat yourself to a bargain! 

Regards,
HeroCraft PC Team

notes.title: New Organs Please update to fix minor errors
notes.content:
Greetings! 

Thank you all very much for supporting the release of Organs Please! We've heard your feedback and have prepared a patch to fix a few minor bugs. 

What's new in the patch: 

 Fixed a bug where the player would receive a penalty for special characters who can't be shaved.

Remember to update Organs Please through Steam to receive the new patch. Now, get back to work, meatbag!

Regards,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: We're dropping a new update for Twitch streamers!
notes.content:
Greetings!

The Human Survival Committee is proud to announce the release of a brand new update that wasn't in Organs Please.

Firstly, for those who love to stream on Twitch, we have added a new feature that allows your viewers to decide the fate of visitors in the game. All you need to do is press a special button and your viewers can choose between allowing the person onto the Ark, hiring them as a Factory worker, or even incinerating them – you'll have to follow their choice.
 
Surviving in a post-apocalyptic and bloodthirsty society just became a little more fun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/32bbd7cda8893f492d742a0cfa19d796b014bd44.jpg

Secondly, we have implemented a survey system for all viewers. Between 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. every game day, your Twitch viewers can vote on whether to take positive or negative action against the Factory Administrator (in other words, you!).

They can give you humanitarian aid in the form of property and lives, a cash bonus, or an increase in assembly parts for the Ark.

But you should be careful, because they can also activate unexpected inspections or close important areas of the Factory. You'd better do your best to stay on their good side.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_e0676c2ad6e84713aa2eba8906eefaf8~mv2.gif

Lastly, in addition to deciding the fate of ordinary citizens, players will also be able to decide the fate of celebrities, including famous murderers, cannibals (not just Virtus Populi followers!), maniacs, space travelers, and political figures. Who will you save and who will you turn into food for the rest of Vert-5? We can't wait to see!

Furthermore, we have completely updated all Faction Principles, fine-tuned the balance, and added even more variety to the appearances of normal and faction visitors.

We hope you enjoy it! Please share your impressions here or on Discord – the Human Survival Committee is always open to receive suggestions and feedback. 

Regards,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: Fungal Threat, Little Horror Farm, and more in the Organs Please update!
notes.content:
Greetings!

The Human Survival Committee is happy to see everyone who survived the harsh factory life from last year. But it's too soon to relax. Next week, you will face new challenges and will need to make some very tough decisions. What exactly will you have to deal with?

The fourth week of the Organs Please storyline will begin. It will feature even more inspectors and unscheduled tasks, tough Faction orders, and a range of other duties for the Factory administrator to complete.

The Factions have already prepared a list of 18 new quests. And the Human Survival Committee will put you in charge of fighting the mushroom infection. Be careful not to touch anyone, because they might just seem like a fun guy.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_d52eaa1441d14260bd0050abe09a81b2~mv2.gif

The Syndicate will need your help to combat their competition, while the Virtus Populi is organizing a mass festival to celebrate the upcoming departure, and the Government is fighting the disgruntled in very peculiar ways.

The Hands of Earth and the Revolutionary brigade take their fight to a new level and restore the planet's ecosystem. Will you create a Little Horror Farm and breed future flora, or grow bushes right on the heads of the government fools? We don't even know which to choose.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_c5e22870c2ce4d50aa4a3cc88bc02db8~mv2.gif

The Revolutionary brigade is even willing to get its hands dirty… including yours. It's time to decide whose side you're on. Speaking of which…

In this update, the Faction Principles levels 7 and 8 will open up once you reach level 8. You'll have to decide who you'll support and choose a Faction Path. We caution you to act wisely as there will be no turning back.

In addition to the big gameplay elements, we've finished working on the sound effects for the week 4 mechanics. We hope you'll love it… or we'll recycle you.

Download the build from Steam; play and share your impressions with us! As a reminder, you can get in touch with the Committee in the discussions on Steam or in Discord.

Regards,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: Update Organs Please and prepare for a bloody good time!
notes.content:
Greetings!

The first Organs Please content update is ready to download and play. It contains the next story week with brand new challenges for the Factory Administrator.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_f7e79f8a00d4401f82d9b789468440af~mv2.gif 

The Committee and the survivors face a new plague on Vert-5 that threatens to decimate humanity. Together with the Committee, you must eradicate the disease with a mass vaccination of the colonists. 

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_e50d75f6242348869877ca5361526f11~mv2.gif

As a special mission, the Committee will arm you with a stun gun… and some visitors might not be too happy with the shocking news. 

Faction representatives will regularly stop by the checkpoint and give you  new quests. Make no mistake, the fate of all citizens of Vertical-5 depends on your choices. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/f164b0c14e5ecd767824bdefea772957afed55ed.png

The Committee has also prepared the launch of the new Goods and Resource Sections. They have passed the final inspection and are ready to operate at full capacity.

In addition, we have also:

 Asked the Inspector to alert you when you have 0 stars of Committee confidence left. 
 Updated the list of Ark construction orders.
 Added a warning about quitting the game without saving.
 Improved and updated the in-game encyclopedia.
 Added access to the Faction Services base window.
 Improved the visuals of the Factory, adding animations and VFX for the sections.
 Fixed a bug with the display of completed orders in the list after building a section.

All improvements are aimed at increasing the efficiency of your work. Do not let down the Committee and humanity – the construction of the Ark must be completed on time. 

Please share your appeals, requests, and complaints about the work of the Factory here and on Discord. May the blessings of the Meat God be with you!

Sincerely,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: Community items! Craft the badge or be recycled!
notes.content:
Greetings!

The Human Survival Committee has prepared special merit badges and prizes for the most efficient workers at the Plant. 

 Badge (6 levels).
 6 Emoticons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/664907d3c4fb19ca451078de1a10617afdce7d32.png

Make sure to decorate your profile with awards, because the Committee will perform inspections and may recycle anyone who does not have the right page design.

Regards,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: Grand Opening of the Factory and Plans of the Committee!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

The celebratory ribbon has been cut, the workers are ready for their assignments, the workshops are running, and the Factory administrator's office is waiting for you. You have thirty days to build the Ark, the spaceship that will carry humanity to our new home: Planet 42.

[previewyoutube=jrmLEzxueFo;full][/previewyoutube]

Let's see what you'll encounter during this difficult thirty-day challenge. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/a804c3ad13d13901bce16323154aed7d075518ac.jpg

Early Access release

You'll be able to play through the first and second story weeks of Organs Please. These will teach you the basic mechanics of checking visitors at the checkpoint. Be on the lookout for terrorists armed with bombs, make sure to test potential colonists with your trusty spoon, and so much more. 

Open up ten basic Resource Factory Sections and three Goods Sections. As the Administrator, you will have to provide the factions and inhabitants of the Ark with food, clothing, and other necessities. 

As the Factory administrator, you will also learn the fundamental Faction Principles and begin to apply them to your work.

Do not disappoint us or you will be recycled. This is your only warning.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/470b17f1c875ca435aa8600d2c393d38319c6f60.jpg

Update 1

The third story week of the game will be available in Update 1, during which an epidemic will break out at the Factory. You will have to forcibly vaccinate every colonist and worker. This gigantic task is not an easy one – people are outraged – so we will allocate you a stun gun to help keep order. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/d9955534899b3b8e2e4d87958006fe75dd4a3d90.jpg

The Government is also determined to test a control chip, and the other Factions with new story quests are waiting for their hour.

Two more checkpoint mechanics will also be available. The Save Humanity Committee is keeping these a secret for now. 

As the Factory administrator, you will also have access to the new Faction Principles, including “Behavior Correction” from the Government and “Contraband” from the Tricelli Syndicate.

Additional Goods Sections are also scheduled to open this week by the Committee: “Durable fiber”, “Polymers”, and two more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/4dd304c8ac1a988870b11ba3ab65ed5ca8ffd154.jpg

As you can see, the third week will be full of exciting… or outlandish events. We will not bother you with the details of new events at the Factory and the description of new achievements. Instead, we will let them be a pleasant (or not so pleasant) surprise for you.

Update 2

Update 2 introduces the fourth story week of the game, in which you must remove chips, check visitors with a Geiger counter, and more to secure the Ark and the Factory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/4750033a3352f49b9211a46fd059a799fd056817.jpg

Be sure to develop relationships with all of the Factions to unlock new principals: “Illegal recreational practices” from the Syndicate, “Underground People” from the Hands of Earth, and more.

Another Goods Section will begin operations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/22b1a4c423e52ae03e4165f2708e4c91bbef9e9b.jpg

There will be brand new quests. The mission to save humanity is threatened by a mushroom infection, radiation and mutants, the Syndicate takes revenge for disrupted business, the Hands of Earth prepares an epochal exposure, and that's not all!

Don't expect to sit quietly at the checkpoint: new events at the Factory won't let your work turn into a routine. But the better you do, the more likely you are to earn more achievements.


Full release

In the Full Release, we will open the fifth and final week of the Organs Please storyline. The fifth story week prepares new challenges for the Factory administrator, and all the hard choices throughout the game will culminate into one of several finales.

If you're hoping to exhale before completing the Ark, you're mistaken. The inhabitants of the Vert-5 are being overrun by new plagues: brain slugs and vermin. And you'll have to work extra hard to get rid of these.

Moreover, four new checkpoint mechanics will be added to ensure that only the most deserving are let onto the Ark.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/96dc4619d22a5b236eda07f80a7242fe106c9928.png

Relationships with the different Factions will reach a whole new level. Faction Paths will open up, each of which significantly changes the course of the game.

You will be able to open special Faction Factory Sections that produce unique faction goods.

You won't get bored with the next new Factory events and new achievements.

And finally, the final quest: The Human Survival Committee and each Faction are getting ready to depart. What will happen? The plot depends on the Faction Path you choose.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/8f9fcf0c5a322d167a60526343725e26f8f55c46.jpg

As you can see, the thirty days from the opening of the Factory to the tightening of the last nut in the Ark will be filled with events, challenges, and encounters with extraordinary heroes. We hope you have fun and enjoy playing Organs Please.

We're open to comments and suggestions, which you can share in Discord or the Steam Discussions. The Human Survival Committee considers all appeals. 

Regards,
Organs Please Team

notes.title: Find out how we're fine-tuning Organs Please
notes.content:
Greetings! 

You'll be happy to know that we are fine-tuning Organs Please before it releases into Early Access. Here are just some of the changes we've been working on.

Players will now receive additional rewards for increasing the Survivability rate. For example, receiving a pass for hiring a new worker, reduced time when collecting Ark orders, additional orders in the queue, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/f292475ae2e452501787d7b7672dbb052b777646.png

There are also rewards for completing Ark orders (besides the reward for saving humanity). You can count on an increase in resources and goods, the ability to build new workshops, and more.

All of this means that the quality of people you let onto the Ark and the speed in which you complete orders will play a much greater role in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40274367/98500c862ccacdd61a7e042ceed947781f817939.jpg

If you have played the Organs Please demo, you should already be familiar with events in the Factory. Different incidents and events  affect elements of the Factory's management: the productivity of the shops, and the loyalty and stress of the workers. We've added some new events related to certain triggers in the game. 

In addition, we have also: 

 Added new music and sound effects.
 Finished models for the second in-game week and are now working on animations. 
 Completed the in-game encyclopedia. 
 Finalized levels 5 and 6 of Principles of Factions.
 Been busy finalizing the in-game interface.
  
Add Organs Please to your Wishlist and join our Discord to stay in touch. 

Regards,
Organs Please Team
